name: metrifi
description: One MetriFi sign-in connects Codex to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) and adds the MetriFi skills: client-report for auditing an institution's existing site, and generate-claude-design-system, generate-claude-design-page and page-design-process for designing and building one. Analyze, design and edit conversion-optimized credit-union and bank websites the MetriFi way.
